findings.description:
Log (dataset/positive/difficulty_stratified/original/tier1/contracts/ds_t1_027.sol#56-81) contract sets array length with a user-controlled value:
	- History.push(LastMsg) (dataset/positive/difficulty_stratified/original/tier1/contracts/ds_t1_027.sol#78)

Reentrancy in ETH_FUND.CashOut(uint256) (dataset/positive/difficulty_stratified/original/tier1/contracts/ds_t1_027.sol#37-50):
	External calls:
	- msg.sender.call.value(_am)() (dataset/positive/difficulty_stratified/original/tier1/contracts/ds_t1_027.sol#44)
	State variables written after the call(s):
	- balances[msg.sender] -= _am (dataset/positive/difficulty_stratified/original/tier1/contracts/ds_t1_027.sol#46)
	ETH_FUND.balances (dataset/positive/difficulty_stratified/original/tier1/contracts/ds_t1_027.sol#11) can be used in cross function reentrancies:
	- ETH_FUND.CashOut(uint256) (dataset/positive/difficulty_stratified/original/tier1/contracts/ds_t1_027.sol#37-50)
	- ETH_FUND.Deposit() (dataset/positive/difficulty_stratified/original/tier1/contracts/ds_t1_027.sol#25-35)
	- ETH_FUND.balances (dataset/positive/difficulty_stratified/original/tier1/contracts/ds_t1_027.sol#11)

Reentrancy in ETH_FUND.Deposit() (dataset/positive/difficulty_stratified/original/tier1/contracts/ds_t1_027.sol#25-35):
	External calls:
	- TransferLog.AddMessage(msg.sender,msg.value,Deposit) (dataset/positive/difficulty_stratified/original/tier1/contracts/ds_t1_027.sol#32)
	State variables written after the call(s):
	- lastBlock = block.number (dataset/positive/difficulty_stratified/original/tier1/contracts/ds_t1_027.sol#33)
